mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 in a single month
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, 20-day forward returns do not outperform a 5-day rolling average by more than 0.5 percentage points in inflation-up periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 150,000 new jobs monthly is associated with stronger consumer demand and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In regimes with high unemployment, or during recessions, the 60-day forward return is negative or indistinguishable from zero (mean diff < 0.1% with wide 95% CI).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO falling below 108) indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which tends to depress near-term earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods of excess supply (e.g., high inventory ratios), the mechanism fails to produce statistically significant negative returns (p > 0.10 for t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales momentum (HOUST > 1,250 units in a month) reflects stronger consumer confidence and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by > 100 units month-over-month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: In deflationary regimes or during high uncertainty (e.g., geopolitical shocks), the 20-day forward return is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% for two consecutive months, the higher real interest rate path suppresses growth expectations and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods of extreme monetary tightening, the effect is muted or reversed (20-day returns positive or flat).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment (UNRATE falling below 3.5%) signals labor market tightening and tends to drive up equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In non-inflationary or low-growth regimes, the signal fails to predict returns (p > 0.10 for out-of-sample test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both industrial production (INDPRO > 108) and retail sales (HOUST > 1,200) indicates broad-based demand expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal is not statistically significant in regimes with high uncertainty or during supply chain disruptions (e.g., pandemic shocks).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in manufacturing activity (GDPC1 falling for three consecutive quarters) reflects weak demand absorption and tends to depress earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases for three consecutive quarterly periods
failure_condition: During periods of excess capacity or deflation, the mechanism is not robustly predictive (p > 0.10 for walk-forward test).
